## Failed Tests — Detail

### ❌ Multi Lives and Policies (ACB-4394) › MLP-13/AC13/BR-A: the "Add life" button is disabled once 10 lives exist

**Acceptance Criteria (from user story):**

> AC13 / Business Rule: Given I have already added 10 lives to the current quote, When I attempt
> to add an 11th life, Then the "+Life" button should be disabled And I should not be able to add
> any additional lives. (Business Rules row: "Maximum 10 lives can be added to a quote".)
> 
> Steps to reproduce:
> 1. Open a new quote; for each life set minimum details + a priced Life cover, then click "Add life".
> 2. Repeat until 10 lives exist.
> 3. Check the "Add life" button disabled state.
> 
> Expected: 10 lives is the max; the "Add life" button is disabled at 10 lives.

**Assertion failure:**

```
TimeoutError: locator.click: Timeout 15000ms exceeded.
Call log:
  - waiting for locator('input[id*="Input_AgeNextBirthday"]').first()
    - locator resolved to <input max="75" min="11" step="1" value="35" required="" data-input="" type="number" pattern="[0-9]*" aria-required="true" id="b15-Input_AgeNextBirthday" class="form-control OSFillParent"/>
  - attempting click action
```
